All three gate commands pass.", "notes_for_reviewer": "Found and fixed a real bug during verification: the task's suggested 24×24 ::before hit-area overlay on the spark cells overlaps so much at their 10px pitch that a day's overlay covered more than half of its left neighbour's visible pixels, silently toggling the wrong day on 6 of 7 cells. Capped the overlay to 12×26px — the largest size provably clear of a neighbour's own 7px bar — documented with the arithmetic in styles.css. This falls short of the literal '24×24' on width, which is geometrically impossible at this pitch without widening the visible spacing (forbidden by the same instruction); please sanity-check that trade-off. Also: no new *.test.ts/tsx file was added since this task's acceptance criteria are all interaction/visual and the Vitest setup has no DOM/jsdom — verification was done via a scripted Playwright click-through instead (details in docs/STATE.md). Plain `--headless=new`/`--headless` Chrome via the CLI silently floors small --window-size values to ~500px CSS width while still naming the output file with the requested dimensions, which initially looked like a false horizontal-overflow bug — worth remembering for future screenshot verification in this repo." }
